sources.title: Captain
sources.snippet: Harnessing the power of AI to optimize conservation efforts We use reinforcement learning to train models for conservation prioritization that best use the available data and resources. CAPTAIN models can work with basic species distribution data but can handle complex multidimensional data and their temporal trends, including land use and climate change.

sources.snippet: Tracking AI is a cutting-edge application that unveils the political biases embedded in artificial intelligence systems. Explore and analyze the political leanings of AIs with our intuitive platform, designed to foster transparency in the world of artificial intelligence. Stay informed and uncover the political inclinations shaping the algorithms behind the technology revolution.
